=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:101-113 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When CUSTOM_TESTS_JSON parses successfully but yields zero executable commands, the script calls tap_not_ok without first emitting a TAP plan header.
  WHY: TAP consumers expect a plan line before any test results; the zero-count path emits malformed TAP and can fail CI, and all six reviewers flagged the same gap.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:107-112 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The raw Jinja block around `test_count=${#TEST_LIST[@]}` is reported to render literally, breaking count logic.
  WHY: The reviewer says the rendered script would not compute the test count correctly, which would make the harness non-functional for real node-runtime manifests.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/30_graceful_shutdown.sh.j2:16-27 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The python3 skip path exits before cleaning up the temporary bin_dir/symlink.
  WHY: Reviewers report leftover filesystem/PATH state in temp or shared environments; both reviewers flagged the same cleanup gap.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:28 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The inline `command -v "$1"` check is reported as missing a leading space after the command word.
  WHY: The reviewer says this can mis-handle quoting/argument boundaries and break tool validation for certain tool names.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:26-29 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The loop variable is reported as unquoted, creating word-splitting risk for tool names with spaces or shell metacharacters.
  WHY: The reviewer says unsafe TOOL_LIST values could be expanded incorrectly and corrupt TAP output or command execution.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:14 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The raw Jinja block around `tool_count=${#TOOL_LIST[@]}` is reported to leave the literal `{% raw %}...{% endraw %}` text in the rendered script.
  WHY: The reviewer says the rendered script would not compute the canary count correctly, breaking TAP plan and tool validation.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/90_tap_report.sh.j2:9-13 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The TAP_PLAN guard is reported to run before any plan header and to reject valid runtime overrides.
  WHY: The reviewer says this can early-exit on valid non-default values and violate the harness validation conventions.

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:28 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Inside the Docker exec template, command string uses `command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1` without a leading space after the command word in the inline shell call, making it vulnerable to word-splitting/interpretation issues for tool names that begin with digits or special characters.
  WHY: The lack of space causes the command here-doc to mishandle quoting and argument boundaries, possibly misparsing the tool name or executing unintended commands.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:26-29 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Loop variable is used without quoting leading to potential word splitting: `for tool in "${TOOL_LIST[@]}"` inside a Docker exec context that may inject unsafe external values into the tool list.
  WHY: If any tool string contains spaces or shell metacharacters, the exec command expands them incorrectly and can execute unintended commands or cause TAP plan corruption.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-runtime/tests/30_graceful_shutdown.sh.j2:16-27 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The skip path exits immediately after printing "ok 1 … # SKIP …" without cleaning up the created `bin_dir` and symlink to dirname.
  WHY: Filesystem pollution in CI environments can affect subsequent runs or host tool behavior, and the leaked path modification could subtly change dirname semantics.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
